systems.owner: Federal Government; the policy is maintained by the Federal Ministry of Communications
systems.tiers: Federal ministries, departments and agencies; to be federated later with state portals so that a search links to state and local government datasets

note: A federal open data policy of July 2018 applying to federal bodies only; local governments appear once, as a future source of datasets linked from Data.gov.ng. Nothing on local government offices or their connection.
